text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Trainers whose assigned 
Umamusume had safely completed their debut 
races gathered to share information.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Aoi Kiryuin, a fellow novice 
trainer from the same class, mentions that 
the support of the Three Goddesses saved 
her despite her lack of experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even with her prior training experience, 
Trainer Riko Kashimoto mentioned that she, 
too, would give anything to acquire the 
knowledge of the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rookie or veteran, the weight of carrying 
an Umamusume's dream remains the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after the Debut race, I reaffirmed my 
resolve to continue running alongside my 
Umamusume, deepening our bond along the 
way.
